name: Macrophage–osteoclast lineage regulation via M-CSF signaling
rationale: Members concern M-CSF/CSF1 signaling, macrophage proliferation and fusion, and osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption; unlike C1/C2 (monocyte/DC differentiation) it covers osteoclasts, and unlike C3/C4 (DAP12) it is driven by M-CSF.

name: Platelet activation by soluble-agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation; the ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PAR, thromboxane TP and prostacyclin receptor members distinguish it from C2/C4 (collagen/GPIb adhesion) and from C1/C3 (integrin/Rap1 signaling).

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and the convergent-extension movements it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation, neural plate and organogenesis, which C1/C2 (axial mesoderm, neural patterning) lack and C3/C4 cover only partly.

name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by Gi/z-coupled receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of cAMP through inhibitory G alpha i/z (alpha-2 adrenergic, G alpha z, AC inhibitory pathway); unlike C1 it lacks PKA activation, and unlike C2-C4 it lacks muscarinic/serotonergic receptors and catecholamine secretion.

name: Cytotoxic lymphocyte regulation by NK cell receptors
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and cytokine output through NK surface receptors and MHC class Ib recognition, which distinguishes it from C1-C4 (KIR, granzyme death, tolerance, T cell proliferation).

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb mesenchyme morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of face, palate, nose, neurocranium, viscerocranium, limbs and digits from mesenchyme; limbs and palate separate it from C2-C4 (pharyngeal organs, ear) and C1 (ossification, cartilage).

name: Fibroblast cell–matrix adhesion with fibronectin assembly
rationale: Members cover fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion assembly, integrin production, fibroblast migration and SRF-linked cytoskeleton; this differs from C1/C2/C4 (syndecan/integrin surface interactions, stress fibers) and C3 (EMT/YAP stromal programme).

name: Restraint of skeletal myogenesis during muscle atrophy
rationale: Members negatively regulate myoblast and myotube differentiation and muscle development, maintain satellite cells and mediate atrophy from inactivity via SCF ubiquitin ligases, unlike C3 (pro-myogenic) and C2/C4 (hypertrophy, adaptation).

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern recombinational telomere maintenance (D-loop, t-circles, capping) with DNA unwinding, break-induced replication and resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates, which the confusables lack.

name: cAMP synthesis driving protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members span cAMP generation (forskolin, cAMP biosynthesis, GPCR cyclic nucleotide signaling) to PKA activation; unlike C1/C3/C4 it lacks CREB, and unlike C2 it concerns activation rather than inhibition of adenylate cyclase.

name: COPI-coated vesicle targeting between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi with COPI budding and retrograde traffic, distinguishing it from C2/C3 (COPII export), C4 (tethering) and C1 (ER protein insertion).

name: Embryonic kidney development through nephron tubule patterning
rationale: Members span nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric nephron formation, with nephron segment patterning (S-shaped body, loop of Henle, distal tubule) that C1/C2/C4 (ureteric bud induction) lack.

name: Endosome–plasma membrane recycling with vesicular cholesterol transport
rationale: Members cover endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome-to-plasma-membrane and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport; vesicular cholesterol transport and the Golgi-trafficking module separate it from C1/C2 (constitutive secretion), C3 (retrograde to Golgi) and C4 (tubulation).

name: Transcriptional restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members are transcriptional programmes of myeloid progenitors (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, unlike C3/C4 (positive differentiation, trafficking) and C1/C2 (granulocyte commitment).

name: RAF–MEK–ERK cascade activity and its feedback inactivation
rationale: Members concern RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation including oncogenic mutants, plus ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, lacking the upstream RAS GAP (C1/C4) and SOS activation (C2/C3) members.

name: Vitamin metabolism featuring vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members concern metabolism of and responses to vitamins K, C and E, with vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation distinguishing it from C2-C4 (vitamin E, D, ubiquinol) and C1 (oxygen transport).

name: Dendritic cell chemokine production via cGAS–STING signaling
rationale: Members concern dendritic and myeloid cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production with positive cGAS–STING signaling and cGAMP import, unlike C1 (STING restraint, IFN-beta), C3 (TLR7/9) and C4 (IL-12/Th1).

name: Noncoding RNA maturation by methylation
rationale: Members concern rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and tRNA processing, RNP assembly and Cajal body localization, with methylation (2'-O, base, cap, box C/D) distinguishing it from C1/C4 (pseudouridylation) and C2 (diphthamide).

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translation control
name: Stress granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members concern RNA-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation (HuR, AUF1, IGF2BP, PKR, L13a), with stress granule assembly and disassembly separating it from the confusables' decay machinery (TTP, KSRP, decapping).

name: Chondrocyte differentiation during cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis, unlike C2/C3 (articular cartilage homeostasis) and C1/C4 (tendon, ossification).

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion control by nutrients and incretins
rationale: Members concern pancreatic beta-cell insulin processing and secretion regulated by glucose, KATP channels, fatty acids, GLP-1/GIP and neurotransmitters, whereas confusables cover insulin action (GLUT4, IRS, AKT2).

name: Ubiquitin–proteasome degradation with linkage-specific chain editing
rationale: Members concern linkage-specific ubiquitination and deubiquitination, E1/E2/E3 and DUB families, proteasome assembly and degradation, unlike C1/C4 (ERAD, autophagy) and C2/C3 (neddylation, COP9).

name: Golgi organization and retrograde traffic under Rab/ARF control
rationale: Members concern Golgi assembly, ribbon and stack organization, COPI and intra-Golgi retrograde transport with Rab/ARF regulation, unlike C1-C3 (COPII, TGN-to-lysosome) and C4 (Ral signaling).

name: Proline metabolism
rationale: Members are proline biosynthesis and catabolism plus general amino acid metabolism terms, unlike confusables centred on glycine, serine and glyoxylate.

name: Vitamin A metabolism from retinol to retinoic acid
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport, unlike C1/C2 (cellular response to retinoic acid), C3 (visual retinoid cycle) and C4 (vitamin D).

name: Telomere end protection suppressing recombination and end joining
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protein localization that block recombination and NHEJ at telomeres, unlike C1/C3/C4 (telomere replication, D-loops) and C2 (telomerase extension).

name: Energy-carrier homeostasis via nucleotide and NAD interconversion
rationale: Members concern adenine/guanine nucleotide phosphorylation and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, NAD(P) synthesis and salvage, and phosphocreatine, unlike C1 (apoptosis), C2/C4 (nucleotide biosynthesis regulation) and C3 (PRPP).

name: Telomere length maintenance via telomerase and end replication
rationale: Members cover telomerase recruitment and extension, C-strand synthesis, telomere recombination and capping and replicative senescence, a telomere-specific scope unlike C2/C3 (general DNA repair), C1 (oncogene-induced senescence) and C4 (chromatin).

name: Inflammatory cytokine control by TLR2/4 and NLRP3 sensing
rationale: Members regulate IL-1, IL-6 and TNF production through LPS/lipopeptide TLR2/4-MyD88 signaling and NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes, unlike C2/C3 (TRIF, CD40, interferon) and C4 (caspase-4/5, AIM2, pyroptosis).

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF target activation controlled by AXIN and APC destruction complex stability, unlike C1/C3/C4 (target repression) and C2 (DVL/FZD receptor level).
